title: fix(check-console-intercept-disarm): read every workspace glob, and judge ui packages by the config their runner loads
body:

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #29561

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`check-console-intercept-disarm` 改用仓里唯一的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 解析(`scripts/workspace-enumerator.mjs`),`ui/` 下 40 个包第一次进入这道门;ui 包的测试脚本都用 `--root ../..` 跑,真正加载的是 `ui/vitest.config.mts`,门禁现在拿这份配置替它们判;并在这份配置的每个 project 和 console 的配置里关掉 vitest 的 console 拦截。
- 为什么改:旧解析遇到列表里的注释行就停,ui 整片被漏掉,门禁却照样打印 OK;ui 测试同样会被「全绿却因迟到的 console 写入判红」的竞态打红(#10374)。
- 风险与回滚:不发包;ui 测试的 console 输出改为直接写到进程输出,通过的测试日志会比以前多;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` 的 `rootRedirectedConfigs` 与 `judgeConfig`;`ui/vitest.config.mts` 四个 project 新增的一行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs`,预期 `OK: 120 vitest-running package(s)`(修前是 80)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**The parse.** `workspaceGlobs()` kept a private copy of the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` parse that ended the `packages:` list at the first line that was neither a `- glob` item nor blank. The list carries a comment block after `examples/*`, so `ui`, `ui/packages/*`, `ui/apps/*` and `ui/examples/*` were never read. It now calls `readWorkspaceGlobs()` from `scripts/workspace-enumerator.mjs`, the repo's one parse, which skips a whole-line comment inside the list and needs no dependency. The card offered a YAML parser or skipping comment lines; the shared parse does the second and is already the module nine other scripts read.

**What the fixed gate then reported: 40 ui packages.**

| Package | Runner | Disposition |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `ui` (root member) | `ui/vitest.config.mts`, four inline projects plus the console project path | disarmed in each inline project's own test block (`unit`, `dom`, `dom-heavy`, `dist`) — the gate already holds that a root-level setting is inert for project runs |
| `ui/apps/console` | its own `vitest.config.ts`, loaded as a project of the root config | disarmed in its own test block |
| 37 `ui/packages/*` and `ui/examples/schema-catalog` | no config of their own; every vitest script is `vitest run --root ../.. ...` | judged by `ui/vitest.config.mts`, the config their runner loads (see below) |

**Why the 38 are not given package-root configs.** With `--root ../..`, vitest 4.1.12's `createVitest` sets the root to `ui/` and looks for its config from there (`options.root || process.cwd()`, then `--config` resolved against that root or a `vitest.config.*` search from it). A config file in the package directory is never opened, so 38 new files would satisfy the gate and change nothing at run time. `ui/AGENTS.md` also forbids a per-package config: `ui/vitest.config.mts` is the ui tree's one test config.

**So the gate follows `--root`.** A package with no package-root config whose every vitest script names `--root DIR` (or `-r`) is judged by the config vitest loads from `DIR` (`--config` resolved against `DIR` when given), under the same three rules: the re-arm refusal, the disarm requirement, and the per-project rule. It is a resolution rule like the existing preset re-export, not a waiver: a redirected config that does not disarm reds every package that runs through it, by name. A package with any vitest script that lacks `--root`, or a root holding no config, keeps the no-config finding. A package with its own package-root config is judged exactly as before.

**The declaration.** `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` gains the four ui members' pairs (`ui/package.json` and `ui/vitest.config` for the literal member, the `/*/package.json` and `/*/vitest.config.*` pair for each glob), which the drift check now owes. The `ui` member's pair also covers the read a redirected package makes of `ui/vitest.config.mts`.

## Tests

Five self-test cases, battery floor 16 to 21:

- a comment line (and a blank line) between workspace globs keeps every glob after it: the parsed globs are asserted, and a member after the comment is scanned;
- a `--root` package with no config passes when the config at that root disarms;
- it fails when that config does not, and the finding names the config vitest loads;
- `--config` beside `--root` is resolved against that root;
- one vitest script without `--root` keeps the no-config finding.

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`)</summary>

- Old parse put back in `workspaceGlobs()`: self-test exit 1. The comment case fails (`parsed packages/*`), the four `--root` cases fail, and the real-tree drift pins fail (`stale: ui/package.json, ui/vitest.config, ...`).
- `rootRedirectedConfigs()` replaced with `null`: the gate exits 1 with 38 `NO package-root vitest config` findings; three `--root` self-test cases fail.

</details>

<details><summary>Runtime probe: the disarm takes effect in the ui projects</summary>

Two throwaway tests under `ui/packages/types/src` (one `.test.ts` in `unit`, one `.test.tsx` in `dom`), each writing a marker with `console.log`, run with `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run ... --silent=false`:

- HEAD config: both markers printed raw, 0 `stdout |` reporter headers: the writes did not go over the worker RPC.
- Base config (`git restore --source=BASE`): 0 markers printed: the writes went over the RPC to the reporter.
- Probe files removed and the config restored to the HEAD blob, verified by hash.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Package counts.** Gate before: `OK: 80 vitest-running package(s)`. After the parse fix alone: 40 ui findings (`ui/vitest.config.mts`, `ui/apps/console/vitest.config.ts`, 38 no-config packages). After this PR: `OK: 120 vitest-running package(s)`. `pnpm -r ls --depth -1` lists 130 workspace packages (41 under `ui/`); `ui/examples/hello-world` runs no vitest script.
- **Log volume.** With the intercept off, console output from passing ui tests is written straight to the process instead of being dropped by the non-TTY reporter's `passed-only` default. Measured on the console project: a 228 KB log for 291 files. The core packages made the same trade when this gate landed.
- **The local ui suite was narrowed.** The full `ui` suite is 5547 files (about 24,000 s of per-file time in `ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json`). Locally: the console project (291 files), `ui/scripts/` (170 files), the probe and `type-check:vitest-config`. Test UI runs all 16 shards in CI.
- **Boundary.** The per-project rule reads inline project blocks only. The console project is a path entry in `ui/vitest.config.mts`, so it is judged through `ui/apps/console`'s own package-root config, not through the root config.

## Verification

Local, on head `f9b9435a78` (`origin/main` merged, `pnpm build` exit 0):

<details><summary>Derived gates: 47 derived, 47 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 47 commands for the three changed files. All 47 exited 0, exit codes captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: `47 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 47 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 47 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.

- `node scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs`: `OK: 120 vitest-running package(s)`
- `node scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs --self-test`: `self-test OK: 20 cases + real-tree population floor + watch-hint declaration.`
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`: `1945 cases pass; 7 slow section(s) deferred`
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`, `Tests 4972 passed | 2 skipped`
- `pnpm check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` read `dist/`. Each exited 3 before the build and 0 after it.

</details>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console test`: `Test Files 291 passed (291)`, `Tests 2813 passed (2813)`
- `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:vitest-config`: exit 0

`skip-changeset`: no published file changes. `@object-ui/console` ships `dist`, `plugin.*` and `README.md`, not `vitest.config.ts`; the `ui` root is private; `scripts/` is not published.
